description: Ciclovia del Sole - percorso is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Comune di Bologna. La ciclovia del Sole è un percorso ciclabile in progetto che inizia a Capo Nord e termina a La Valletta. Attraversa ben otto nazioni: Norvegia, Finlandia, Svezia, Danimarca, Germania, Repubblica Ceca, Austria e Italia.La ciclovia pubblicata in questo dataset è una parte del tratto italiano inaugurato nel mese di aprile del 2021. Coverage: Comune di Bologna. The portal files it under the publisher Comune di Bologna. Its tags are infrastrutture, mobilita-persone-e-merci, turismo-di-prossimita. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, GEOJSON, GPX, JSON, JSON_LD. The portal shows 2026-09-29 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support cycling and walking network and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
